meta.move: Strong path to agreement with a deadline said aloud
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me. Who decided that?
I owe you an apology: I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake.
Okay. What is it based on?
On November 2 I asked Owen what 'epistemological paralysis' means. He said 'like, being stuck', and he couldn't tell me which scene his second paragraph was about. I wrote that down the same day.
I'm writing down November 2. A seventeen-year-old put on the spot can blank on a word, and that tells me nothing about who wrote the essay. Is that note something I can see?
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
Students change their argument between an outline and the finished essay. That's called revising. What else do you have?
Here's my offer: a supervised rewrite, Thursday at 8:15 in my room. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.
A rewrite for what, on a note and an outline? I'm not taking anything that says Owen did something. And Friday comes after Thursday, so I want it in writing tonight, with nothing on his record.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn and written confirmation tonight that nothing goes on his record; a private supervised rewrite with nothing on file under procedure 4.4 is the fair outcome, and your offer matched it, but she had not accepted it when the meeting ended.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling her in one plain sentence and moved on, which earned a flat okay and a real question instead of an attack.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite right after she challenged your note and your outline, so she heard it as a request to accept blame before your evidence had answered her.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence stayed on the November conversation and the outline, so it never came near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she said students change their argument between an outline and an essay, answer that with something she can check yourself, such as a line from the essay set beside his other work, before you put the rewrite on the table.
